provisioning.candidateToolchains: Freeze exact compiler, runtime, parser, schema validator, packaging tools and transitive locks in NF-056-04 for every target.
provisioning.systemDependencies: No additional system packages in the environment probe; inventory inherited tools through the immutable image manifest. Declare candidate-specific libc, native libraries, interpreter, build scripts and cgo variants before comparison.
provisioning.crossBuild: May supplement native builds; never substitutes for execution on the exact target.
provisioning.signing: No signing credentials are provisioned. Signing, notarization and signature lifecycle remain not-tested until separately authorized and evidenced.

datasets.rule: Use the same pinned bytes, ordered library case inventory and transforms for every candidate. Repetition does not merge documents or change identity namespaces. NF-056-03 supplies the shared library inventory.

measurements.candidateOrder: Rotate the four candidates once per repetition; record the actual order.

coldStartMs.cache: fresh process; provisioned dependencies; OS file cache uncontrolled and disclosed

validationMs.cache: warm library process per corpus batch; exclude provisioning and startup

peakMemoryBytes.cache: fresh process; external OS peak resident memory including interpreter; disclose child accounting

artifactBytes.cache: exact hashed distributable plus separately recorded installed/runtime footprint

cleanBuildMs.cache: empty project build cache; pinned provisioned dependency cache; network disabled

cachedBuildMs.cache: unchanged sources and populated project build cache; network disabled

ciMs.cache: job execution excluding queue time; report provisioning/build/test/upload phases and cache hits separately

measurements.summary: Retain every raw sample and failure. Report count, median, min, max and p95 (nearest rank); do not discard outliers. Compare within one target and identical environment cohort only.

comparisonPolicy: Capture exact image version, OS version/build, kernel/libc where applicable, architecture and hardware. If any fingerprint differs, stop comparison; re-freeze a shared contract and rerun all affected candidates. Hosted labels cannot request an old immutable image.

infrastructure.accessEvidence: Repository Actions settings inspected on 2026-10-01; actual standard-runner access is verified by the environment probe workflow.
infrastructure.paidResources: Not authorized; use existing standard hosted runners only.
